* [[Death and funeral of Pope John Paul II]]:
** Various world leaders express their condolences for the death of [[Pope]] [[Pope John Paul II|John Paul II]], including Queen [[Elizabeth II]], [[John Howard]], [[Tony Blair]], [[George W. Bush]], [[Carlo Azeglio Ciampi]] and [[Lawrence Gonzi]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20051104105721/http://afr.com/articles/2005/04/04/1112489383753.html (AFR)]
** [[Pope John Paul II]] [[state funeral|lies in state]] in the [[Clementine Hall|Clementine Room]] of the [[Apostolic Palace]] for a private viewing, a ceremony to confirm and certify the [[death]] of the ''Pontifex Maximus''. [http://www.foxnews.com/story/0,2933,152298,00.html (Fox News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2005/apr/03/catholicism.religion5 (''The Guardian'')]
* [[Iraqi conflict|Conflict in Iraq]]: A group of at least 40 [[Iraqi insurgency (2003–2011)|Iraqi insurgents]] attacks [[Baghdad]]'s [[Abu Ghraib]] prison, using car bombs, grenades, and small arms. At least 20 [[United States|American]] soldiers and 12 [[Iraq]]i prisoners are injured, but the [[US Army]] says it has put down the assault. [https://www.nytimes.com/2005/04/03/international/middleeast/03ghraib.html (NYT)] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/4405337.stm (BBC)]
